Format

  • Regular Season:
    • Round-Robin format league
      • All teams play each other once
      • All matches are Bo2
    • Top 2 teams proceed to the Grand Final
      • Win - 2 points
      • Draw - 1 point
      • Lose - 0 point
    • Tie-breaker: Bo1
  1. Points amassed between tied teams (mini-league)
  2. Map difference between tied teams
  3. Map wins between tied teams
  4. Overall map difference
  5. Overall map wins
  6. Round difference between tied teams
  7. Round wins between tied teams
  8. Overall round difference
  9. Overall round wins
  • Grand Final
    • Best of 3
